messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired — service=runtime-inference, symptom=latency_p99_exceeded, region=us-west-2, threshold=1200ms, triggered_at=1780012345

miguel (oncall): acked. Looking now. Any recent deploys?

sarah (sre): saw a small deploy around 17:50 PST to model-router v2.1. It touched batcher config. Dashboards: https://dash.redwood/runtime-inference?range=15m — p99 ~1.3s, p95 ~650ms.

ryan (runtime): confirming—we pushed a lambda that increased the max_batch_size from 8 -> 16 to reduce cost. That could increase tail latency for short requests. Rolling back now.

miguel (oncall): good call. Before rollback completes, can we short-circuit traffic for high-qps customers to dedicated pool? We have a warm dedicated pool in us-west labelled dp-small.

sarah (sre): I can flip routing. Running: 
```
redwood route set --service runtime-inference --region us-west-2 --route-outbound dp-small --weight 30
```
Will monitor.

product-ops: any known customer impact? CX flagged a single enterprise tenant with increased API timeouts. Need to notify if we do traffic changes.

miguel (oncall): pinging accounts team. Ryan — status of rollback?

ryan (runtime): rollback started, rollout paused at 40%. I reverted the batcher change in canary and stopped rollout. Canary p99 dropped back to ~900ms. Rolling full rollback now.

sarah (sre): route change applied, dp-small receiving ~28% traffic. p99 overall dropped to ~920ms within 60s. p95 back to ~450ms. CPU on dp-small spiked but within headroom.

miguel (oncall): nice. @product-ops pls draft a short note: "We observed elevated tail latency in us-west; rerouted traffic to dedicated capacity and rolled back a batching config. No data loss; performance returning to normal."

product-ops: on it, sending to affected customers now.

miguel (oncall): next steps — create a follow-up issue to evaluate batching defaults, add canary ramp gating for batch size, and add an automated runbook check for batch config diffs. Assigning to ryan + sarah.

ryan (runtime): will do. Creating issue: https://issues.redwood/INF-1084

lia (oncall-next): I'll take handoff. Confirming p99 is trending down and alerts suppressed for 10m?

miguel (oncall): confirmed — p99 at ~880ms and stable for last 3 mins. Pager auto-suppressed. Lia, handoff to you: keep an eye for regressions and follow the runbook in INF-1084.

sarah (sre): adding note — we saw minor KV cache churn after route change, watching eviction rate. If eviction_rate > 5% continue to scale dp-small.

miguel (oncall): thanks everyone. Closing incident thread once product-ops confirms customer messages sent.

product-ops: customer messages sent at 1780012415.

miguel (oncall): closing from on-call side. Follow-ups: INF-1084 (batch gating), INF-1085 (canary ramp policy). :white_check_mark:
